stories.title: 'Bad time to troll': Binance co-founder Zhao asks Musk for support after hack
stories.summary: Binance's cofounder Changpeng Zhao urged Elon Musk to stop mocking the exchange after it suffered a $6.3 billion hack. The SpaceX and Tesla CEO posted a series of emojis on X which appeared to poke fun at the attack, which has seen $3 billion in crypto assets frozen so far.
